name: Tucker Decomposition (HOSVD)
definition: A method building a multiresolution structure where each block is encoded into a rank-reducible basis learned from the input dataset. It applies a tensor decomposition to an N-dimensional input dataset A, decomposing it into a product of N basis matrices U(n) and an N-dimensional core tensor B (Tucker model).
summary: Tucker Decomposition approximates high-dimensional volume data using a core tensor and orthonormal factor matrices, capturing non-axis-aligned features more effectively than separable transforms while providing strict error bounds.
